body: Original logo-free 2994 salvage game vehicle sprite sheet, transparent PNG landscape 7:4, eight complete separated cars in 4 columns 2 rows. Inspired by standard 1998 British Rover Mini Cooper 1.3i with SMALL 12 inch wheels, narrow black wheelarch lips, NOT Sports Pack. Tiny classic upright two-door saloon, round headlights, chrome horizontal grille with no emblem, two small round auxiliary driving lamps, short bonnet, very short overhangs, near vertical windshield, upright rear with small rectangular tail lights, separate boot lid, exposed rain gutters, small side mirrors. Weathered pale turquoise body, faded cream roof, patchy burgundy front fenders, restrained rust and copper repair seams. No stripes, decals, text, logos, plates, badges, numbers. All wheels and tires ABSENT with fully transparent wheel openings for animated tires. No ground or shadows. Same car in eight exact orientations. Top row FRONT straight; FRONT LEFT quarter noseRIGHT; LEFT PROFILE noseRIGHT; REAR LEFT quarter noseRIGHT. Bottom row REAR straight; REAR RIGHT quarter noseLEFT; RIGHT PROFILE noseLEFT; FRONT RIGHT quarter noseLEFT. Full bumpers visible, generous empty gutters, consistent perspective. Detailed painterly photoreal original game art.
dashboard: Original badge-free 2994 cockpit overlay for tiny 1998 British Mini Cooper 1.3i, RIGHT HAND DRIVE. Transparent PNG ultrawide3:1 straight ahead view. Classic compact shallow dashboard: full width warm burl walnut fascia, three circular cream instrument recesses grouped on RIGHT under modest hood (EMPTY unmarked faces without needles for live runtime gauges). Small round analogue clock recess near center, narrow rectangular cassette radio LEFT of center, small round fresh-air vents at far left and far right, walnut glovebox on LEFT. Lower black horizontal shelf with sparse classic rocker switch strip and heater box below center. Thin weathered turquoise painted metal windshield sill and narrow pillars. NO steering wheel, mounting area on RIGHT for separate live animated wheel. No printed text numbers emblems badges needles or static speed readings. Entire upper windshield fully transparent. Dash occupies lower half, no road scenery seats. Original detailed painterly photoreal salvaged year2994 game art, subtle chipped walnut, repaired seams, not a modern BMW Mini dashboard. Keep right instrument region dark empty so runtime speed RPM and gear remain legible.
